UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.

VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are invalid. Please check and try again.

CODE_EXPIRED: This code has expired. Request a new one.
CODE_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED: Too many incorrect attempts. Request a new code.
RESEND_COOLDOWN: Please wait a minute before requesting another code.
INVALID_OR_EXPIRED_LINK: This link is invalid or has expired.
INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
